full_text:
Daily Millionaire - A new lottery game
This is an international lottery game where players have the chance to win up to £1 Million every day if they match 6 numbers from 1-52. 
And that’s not the only way to become a millionaire. This new lottery also includes a special prize bonus: the Millionaire Drop. A portion of the prize pool for each draw is set aside in the “Millionaire’s Fund”. Prize money from this fund will be distributed among the game’s lucky players on the day that all numbers drawn are even or odd. This should theoretically happen every 6 weeks. If, for example, the “Millionaire’s Fund” features £15.5 million, a total of 15 players will be chosen based on the serial number of their lottery ticket. Each of these players win £1 Million.
The price of one line is £1.50.
Players can subscribe to this lottery game for one week, one month or longer. This way, they will never miss a draw where the “Millionaire Drop” occurs. Players can also purchase a share of a pre-paid ticket, such as one-tenth of a monthly ticket for £4.50 and so on.
The draw takes place every evening in Austria.
In the UK, tickets are available for purchase in lottery retail points of sale, online, and on an app.

full_text:
Thunderball
Thunderball is a UK-based lottery game where players can win up to £500,000 four times per week if they correctly match 5 numbers between 1-39 and one number from 1-14. Winners of this game don't have to share their winnings with anyone else.
For one play slip, players can choose a maximum of 7 lines of numbers. They can also buy a maximum of 10 lottery tickets per draw. Players can also purchase multi-draw tickets for several consecutive weeks.
The price of one line is £1.00.
Players can choose their draw dates. The draw takes place every Tuesday, Wednesday, Friday, and Saturday.
Tickets are available for purchase in all usual lottery points of sale, online, and on the app.
